name: VS
recent: V.S. Industry Berhad 在截至2026年7月31日的季度录得营收9.986亿令吉，环比增长24.2%，同比增长16.3%，但净亏损2196万令吉，净利率为-2.2%，较上季度的-4.1%有所收窄。公司非执行董事Wong Cheer Feng在10月多次增持股份，雇员公积金局（EPF）也在10月至11月间持续申报股权变动。此外，公司因行使凭单发行了1275股新股，并于9月15日上市。
notable: 非执行董事Wong Cheer Feng在10月多次增持公司股份，合计约228万股。
公司因凭单转换发行1,275股新股，于2026年9月15日上市。
雇员公积金局（EPF）在10月至11月间多次申报股权变动。
risks: 公司2026财年第四季度净亏损2196万令吉，全年由盈转亏。
董事Wong Cheer Feng在9月表示可能在闭市期间进行交易。
earnings: 截至2026年7月31日的季度，营收为9.986亿令吉，环比增长24.2%，同比增长16.3%；净亏损2196万令吉，净利率-2.2%，较上季度的-4.1%有所改善。

recent_en: V.S. Industry Berhad reported revenue of RM998.6 million for the quarter ended 31 July 2026, up 24.2% QoQ and 16.3% YoY, but recorded a net loss of RM21.96 million with a net margin of -2.2%, narrowing from -4.1% in the previous quarter. Non-Executive Director Wong Cheer Feng acquired shares multiple times in October, while the Employees Provident Fund Board continued to file changes in shareholding from October to November. The company also issued 1,275 new shares from warrant conversion, listed on 15 September.
notable_en: Non-Executive Director Wong Cheer Feng acquired approximately 2.28 million shares in multiple transactions in October.
The company issued 1,275 new shares from warrant conversion, listed on 15 September 2026.
The Employees Provident Fund Board filed multiple changes in shareholding between October and November.
risks_en: The company recorded a net loss of RM21.96 million in 4Q FY2026, swinging to a full-year loss.
Director Wong Cheer Feng indicated intention to deal during the closed period in September.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was RM998.6 million, up 24.2% QoQ and 16.3% YoY; net loss was RM21.96 million with a net margin of -2.2%, improving from -4.1% in the previous quarter.
